hitborders-enabled.name: Enable Hitborders
hitborders-enabled.description: Toggle the Hitborders visualizer on or off live without restarting.

player-opacity.name: Player Opacity
player-opacity.description: Opacity of the player icon while Hitborders is enabled (0.0 to hide, 1.0 full).

hide-wave-trail.name: Disable Wave Trail
hide-wave-trail.description: Hide the stock Geometry Dash wave trail while Hitborders is enabled.

layout-mode.name: Layout Mode
layout-mode.description: Hide decoration objects, force color channels white, and use a flat grey background.

line-thickness.name: Line Thickness
line-thickness.description: Outline and player path thickness in real screen pixels.

merge-outlines.name: Merge Outlines & Fills
merge-outlines.description: Merge overlapping outlines and flatten interior fills into one uniform region with no alpha stacking.

fill-opacity.name: Object Fill Opacity
fill-opacity.description: Flat interior fill opacity for inflated hitborders (0 for outline only).

show-interactables.name: Show Interactables
show-interactables.description: Draw inflated trigger areas for orbs, pads, and portals.

glow.name: Glow
glow.description: Draw a soft glow pass behind outlines and the player path.

hide-inside-hazards.name: Hide Objects Inside Hazards
hide-inside-hazards.description: Opt-in: hide hazards, solids, and interactables completely enclosed inside hazard hitboxes.

only-reachable-borders.name: Only Reachable Borders
only-reachable-borders.description: Opt-in: flood-fill from the player center to hide borders inside walls or unreachable pockets.

color-hazard.name: Hazard Color
color-hazard.description: Color for spikes, saws, and hazard slopes.

color-solid.name: Solid Block Color
color-solid.description: Color for neutral solid blocks and normal slopes.

color-path.name: Player Path Color
color-path.description: Color for the player center line (non-wave modes).

color-wave-path.name: Wave Path Color
color-wave-path.description: Color for the player center line in wave mode.

color-portal.name: Portal Color
color-portal.description: Color for mode, size, mirror, and dual portals.
